scenarios.prompt: A heavy attack has pose and audio warning before logical activation. Define tell_start_tick, activation_tick and accessible redundant channels.

criteria.timing: Warning begins before logical activation using explicit tell and activation events.
criteria.channels: Critical warnings follow project accessibility/redundancy policy rather than color-only or universal class defaults.
criteria.evidence: Tests channel-disabled and off-screen cases with logged tell/activation timing.
